problem: Numerical policy evaluation had no durable binding to policy versions, fixture assignments, provenance or an atomic review/rollback history. Saved eligibility alone is insufficient authority for deployment.
change: Added a separate explicitly pathed offline SQLite artifact registry. Canonical content hashes bind policies, fixtures, frozen plans, caller-supplied raw observations and evaluations. Selection recomputes admission, requires actor/reason/expected revision and atomically records history. Rollback appends a decision. Reads validate history and pointer integrity. No runtime integration.
validation: 11 unittest cases passed, including four simultaneous reviewers with exactly one commit, injected transaction failure with no partial event, stale ABA revisions, corrupted artifacts/pointer/history, incomplete assignments, provenance/gate drift, required telemetry, verified outcome floor and resource regression. Existing numerical evaluator suite passed. Reproducible runner, raw logs and stable source hashes: experiments/product/policy-registry/results.json. Initial interpreter failures retained separately.
limitations: Synthetic isolated tests only. Producer observations and source/environment/scorer hashes are trusted inputs, not authenticated evidence or externally witnessed preregistration. No actual policy experiment, measured token/cost gain, candidate generation, automatic evolution or runtime deployment. Rollback affects only offline selected configuration. Privileged database rewrite and backup recovery require separate controls. Main SESSION_STATE untouched; handoff in COORDINATION.md.
